clips.title: The story
paras: After you took the first sigil from the Syndicate, Zengu sends you after the remaining two, which the dug-in Stromgarde militia guards. Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, broke the Sigil of Thoradin into pieces, and you are to carry them to the troll shaman Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

Three sigils guard the tomb of Thoras Trollbane, and you have already recovered the first from the Syndicate. The other two are harder to get, since the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia holds them. Thoras' son, Galen, divided the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and dispersed them among the Stromgarde defenders.
Zengu tells you to retrieve the pieces from the defenders in Stromgarde and take them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman at Hammerfall, who can bind them into the whole sigil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thoras Trollbane's tomb is protected by three sigils--the first of which you retrieved from the Syndicate. The other two will be harder to get, as they're held by the firmly entrenched Stromgarde militia.

The sigil of Thoradin was divided into eleven pieces by Thoras' son, Galen, and dispersed among the Stromgarde defenders. Retrieve the pieces and bring them to Tor'gan, the troll shaman, he will be able to bind them into the complete sigil.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Throm'ka, adventurer. Zengu informed me that you required my assistance?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you need me to reconstruct this sigil? It shouldn't be too difficult... All the pieces seem to be here and the magical structure will be easy to reform.
You might want to close your eyes.
